summary: Iteration 51: tested merge-duplicates, approval welcome alert, apply-reminders, and the member-apply -> Form Submissions -> approve/decline flow. Backend: 5/5 pytest passed. Frontend: Admin -> Form Submissions -> Memberships tab shows member-decision-status-{uid} 'Awaiting approval' with submission-approve/decline buttons; approving flips the pill to 'Approved member' with success toast. Admin -> Team -> MergeAccounts form and all merge-* data-testids present. Admin -> Members -> admin-waiting box and apply-reminders-toggle render.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~12,634 lines — well beyond the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into modules (members, auth, merge, submissions).
_send_apply_reminders iterates and awaits send_email serially inside the hourly scheduler; a slow SMTP would stall other hourly jobs. Consider a bounded gather or background task.

_merge_pair's 400 'Those are the same account' triggers only when both emails resolve to the same user_id; it also fires if dup_email is actually keep's alt — fine, but surface the 400 message more clearly in the UI toast.
test_credentials: QA admin cookie session_token=qa_tok_123 via /app/backend/tests/qa_session.py (teardown-safe). All applicant test users use qa.*@example.com and are cleaned up at module teardown.
seed_data_creation: Transient: @example.com users, submissions, push_subs, user_sessions, member_ledger, auth_tokens, account_merges — all removed in fixture teardown and a final cleanup pass. qa_session.py up/down toggles the temp admin + staff_notify_email.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with -o addopts='' to bypass pytest.ini xdist. Admin view keys: 'inbox' = Form Submissions, 'members' = Members, 'team' = Team Access. _send_apply_reminders can be invoked directly: `import server; asyncio.run(server._send_apply_reminders())`. CSRF middleware requires X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest on POST/PUT/DELETE when session_token cookie is present. Dup account's session cookie correctly re-points to keep user after merge via on-write migration in /admin/team/merge.
